name: review_file_frame_read
description: Start a job to read exact frames from a source video or a saved project's program as review JPEGs: one time with at, or up to 12 with times. The default 640-pixel picture is enough to identify a shot. Text is reliable only when it is about 8 pixels or taller in the returned picture. To read fine detail, pass region for that part of the frame at its own pixels, or a larger max_edge. Poll file_job_status_read and then call review_file_frame_result_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Reuse for identical retries.

file.description: Absolute path to source video. Reads the source clock.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a saved project.

at.description: Time in seconds, timecode, or exact rational seconds such as 1001/30000.

clock.description: Saved-project clock. Defaults to sequence for a sequence project and assembly for a multicam project. Group reads the group switch lane.

times.description: Several frame times in the same formats as at. The result holds frames in request order and one image per frame. Together the images can total 2 MiB.

max_edge.description: Longest image edge in pixels. Defaults to 640. 1920 to 2576 reads small on-screen text in 4K footage. Token cost grows with the area, so prefer region for detail.

region.description: Return only this part of the picture, keeping its own pixels up to max_edge. Fractions of the picture from its top left: x 0.5, y 0, width 0.5, height 0.5 is the top right quarter.

name: review_file_frame_result_read
description: Read the JPEGs and frame metadata for a successful review_file_frame_read job. Returns one image/jpeg content block per frame, each after a frame label when the job asked for times. native_width and native_height appear when a picture was reduced or cropped. Each image is at most 1 MiB before base64 encoding.
